# defi — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
DeFi product discovery, investment, redemption, and portfolio. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl defi <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

Contents (18): support-chains · support-platforms · list · search · detail · prepare · deposit · redeem · claim · calculate-entry · rate-chart · tvl-chart · depth-price-chart · invest · withdraw · collect · positions · position-detail

### defi support-chains
Get supported chains for DeFi
`ocl defi support-chains`

### defi support-platforms
Get supported platforms for DeFi
`ocl defi support-platforms`

### defi list
List all DeFi products (no filters, paginated)
`ocl defi list [options]`
- `--page-num <PAGE_NUM>` — Page number (min 1, page size fixed at 20)

### defi search
Search DeFi products (earn, pools, lending)
`ocl defi search [options]`
- `--token <TOKEN>` — Comma-separated token keywords (e.g. "USDC,ETH")
- `--platform <PLATFORM>` — Comma-separated platform keywords (e.g. "Aave,Compound")
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. ethereum, avalanche, bsc)
- `--product-group <PRODUCT_GROUP>` — Product group: SINGLE_EARN (default), DEX_POOL, LENDING
- `--page-num <PAGE_NUM>` — Page number (min 1, page size fixed at 20)

### defi detail
Get DeFi product detail and APY
`ocl defi detail --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID>`

### defi prepare
Get pre-investment info (allowance, limits, supported tokens)
`ocl defi prepare --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID>`

### defi deposit
Generate deposit calldata (subscribe, add liquidity, borrow)
`ocl defi deposit --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID> --address <ADDRESS> --user-input <USER_INPUT> [options]`
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance (default "0.01" = 1%) (default 0.01)
- `--token-id <TOKEN_ID>` — Token ID for V3 Pool positions (required for V3 add liquidity to existing position)
- `--tick-lower <TICK_LOWER>` — Lower tick for V3 Pool new position (floor(log(price)/log(1.0001)/tickSpacing)*tickSpacing)
- `--tick-upper <TICK_UPPER>` — Upper tick for V3 Pool new position (ceil(log(price)/log(1.0001)/tickSpacing)*tickSpacing)

### defi redeem
Build redemption/withdrawal calldata for a DeFi product
`ocl defi redeem --id <ID> --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--ratio <RATIO>` — Redemption ratio: "1"=full exit (100%), "0.5"=50%
- `--token-id <TOKEN_ID>` — V3 Pool: NFT tokenId (required for V3 pool redemption)
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance (default "0.01") (default 0.01)
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (for LP token input)
- `--user-input <USER_INPUT>` — User input tokens as JSON array (e.g. '[{"tokenAddress":"0x...","chainIndex":"56","coinAmount":"1.0"},...]') Partial exit: REQUIRED with underlying token add…
- `--token <TOKEN>` — LP token / receipt token contract address (single-token shorthand; use --user-input for V3)
- `--symbol <SYMBOL>` — LP token symbol
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — LP token human-readable amount
- `--precision <PRECISION>` — LP token decimals

### defi claim
Generate reward-claim calldata
`ocl defi claim --address <ADDRESS> --reward-type <REWARD_TYPE> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. ethereum, avalanche)
- `--id <ID>` — Investment product ID (required for REWARD_INVESTMENT / V3_FEE)
- `--platform-id <PLATFORM_ID>` — Protocol platform ID (required for REWARD_PLATFORM)
- `--token-id <TOKEN_ID>` — V3 Pool NFT tokenId (required for V3_FEE)
- `--principal-index <PRINCIPAL_INDEX>` — Principal order index (for UNLOCKED_PRINCIPAL)
- `--expect-output <EXPECT_OUTPUT>` — Expected output token list as JSON array (e.g. '[{"chainIndex":"1","tokenAddress":"0x...","coinAmount":"0.001"}]')

### defi calculate-entry
Calculate exact token amounts needed for V3 pool entry based on input token and amount
`ocl defi calculate-entry --id <ID> --address <ADDRESS> --input-token <INPUT_TOKEN> --input-amount <INPUT_AMOUNT> --token-decimal <TOKEN_DECIMAL> [options]`
- `--tick-lower <TICK_LOWER>` — Lower tick for V3 Pool position
- `--tick-upper <TICK_UPPER>` — Upper tick for V3 Pool position

### defi rate-chart
Get historical APY chart data for a DeFi product
`ocl defi rate-chart --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID> [options]`
- `--time-range <TIME_RANGE>` — Time range: DAY (V3 only), WEEK (default), MONTH, SEASON, YEAR

### defi tvl-chart
Get historical TVL chart data for a DeFi product
`ocl defi tvl-chart --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID> [options]`
- `--time-range <TIME_RANGE>` — Time range: DAY (V3 only), WEEK (default), MONTH, SEASON, YEAR

### defi depth-price-chart
Get V3 Pool depth or price history chart (V3 Pool only)
`ocl defi depth-price-chart --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID> [options]`
- `--chart-type <CHART_TYPE>` — Chart type: DEPTH (default) or PRICE
- `--time-range <TIME_RANGE>` — Time range (only for PRICE mode): DAY (default), WEEK

### defi invest
High-level invest: resolve token, convert amount, build calldata
`ocl defi invest --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID> --address <ADDRESS> --token <TOKEN> --amount <AMOUNT> [options]`
- `--token2 <TOKEN2>` — Second token symbol or contract address (V3 dual-token entry)
- `--amount2 <AMOUNT2>` — Amount in minimal units for second token (V3 dual-token entry)
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (resolves automatically from detail if not provided)
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance (default "0.01" = 1%) (default 0.01)
- `--token-id <TOKEN_ID>` — Token ID for V3 Pool (add to existing position)
- `--tick-lower <TICK_LOWER>` — Lower tick for V3 Pool new position
- `--tick-upper <TICK_UPPER>` — Upper tick for V3 Pool new position
- `--range <RANGE>` — Price range percentage for V3 Pool (e.g. 5 for ±5% around current price)

### defi withdraw
High-level withdraw: resolve position, build exit calldata
`ocl defi withdraw --investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID> --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--ratio <RATIO>` — Redemption ratio ("1" for full exit, "0.5" for 50%)
- `--token-id <TOKEN_ID>` — V3 Pool NFT tokenId
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance (default "0.01" = 1%) (default 0.01)
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Human-readable partial withdrawal amount
- `--platform-id <PLATFORM_ID>` — Platform ID to auto-fetch position detail

### defi collect
High-level collect: auto-build expectOutputList, claim rewards
`ocl defi collect --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> --reward-type <REWARD_TYPE> [options]`
- `--investment-id <INVESTMENT_ID>` — Investment product ID
- `--platform-id <PLATFORM_ID>` — Protocol platform ID
- `--token-id <TOKEN_ID>` — V3 Pool NFT tokenId (for V3_FEE)
- `--principal-index <PRINCIPAL_INDEX>` — Principal order index (for UNLOCKED_PRINCIPAL)

### defi positions
Get user DeFi holdings overview across protocols and chains
`ocl defi positions --address <ADDRESS> --chains <CHAINS>`

### defi position-detail
Get detailed holdings for a specific protocol
`ocl defi position-detail --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> --platform-id <PLATFORM_ID>`
